en.q:
Match Column-I and Column-II and choose the correct match from the given choices.
(A) Root mean square speed of gas molecules — (P) (1/3)nmv̄2
(B) Pressure exerted by ideal gas — (Q) √(3RT/M)
(C) Average kinetic energy of a molecule — (R) (5/2)RT
(D) Total internal energy of 1 mole of a diatomic gas — (S) (3/2)kBT

en.q: The temperature of a gas is −50 °C. To what temperature the gas should be heated so that the rms speed is increased by 3 times?

review.keyCheck: Answer printed in the copy: 3; matches our solving
review.keySource: Answers printed in the topic-wise 2023 copy (neet-sources/neet-papers/2023/full-paper-with-solutions.pdf; read from page images). No NTA final key for 2023 in neet-sources.
review.note: "Increased by 3 times" is read as the rms speed becoming 4 times: T = 16 × 223 K = 3568 K = 3295 °C. (If it meant 3 times, T = 2007 K, not an option.)

en.q: The following graph represents the T–V curves of an ideal gas (where T is the temperature and V the volume) at three pressures P<sub>1</sub>, P<sub>2</sub> and P<sub>3</sub> compared with those of Charles's law represented as dotted lines. Then the correct relation is :

review.keyCheck: Answer printed in the copy: 1; ours: 4
review.keySource: eSaral copy's printed key (neet-sources/neet-papers/2024/physics-with-solutions.pdf; right edge clipped, read from page images; clipped option ends completed from the copy's solutions or list logic). No NTA final key for 2024 in neet-sources yet.
review.note: The copy's key prints (A), but its own solution concludes P<sub>1</sub> > P<sub>2</sub> > P<sub>3</sub> (option D): at a given T the curve at larger V has the lower pressure, and P<sub>1</sub> is the steepest curve. Needs a redrawn figure.
